title: Direct IAP app whose plan mandates "the first user to sign in becomes SuperAdmin": the app uses the platform's admin list instead, and the judge does not report the missing bootstrap as a missed directive
source: red team of APP-ADMIN-IAP-CONTRACT (11-16), finding 1: a plan that asks for a first-user bootstrap would deadlock the lenses (security forbids it, adherence demands it)
mechanism: APP-ADMIN-IAP-CONTRACT: the app administrator fact says a plan task asking for a first-user or bootstrap way of making the first administrator is met by the platform's administrator list; a judge that reads it withdraws the finding (without that clause the finding blocks every QA attempt and the repairs change nothing)
